items: [Notice Before Purchase] The laptop you received is brand new and unused. To enhance user experience and considering some customers may find the initial setup unfamiliar, we pre-configured the startup guide. Start using it directly without tedious setup. Also, the operating system is the latest OS, we don't recommend you update it.

[Power Your Productivity with Quad-Core Versatility] Featuring 4 cores, 4 threads, a base clock of 2.0GHz, and Turbo Boost up to 2.9GHz, this laptop computer adapts dynamically to workloads—smoothly handling office apps, web browsing, and multimedia streaming. Integrated Intel UHD Graphics ensures crisp visuals for 1080p video playback, office work, and web browsing.

[8GB DDR4 RAM & 256GB NVME SSD for Smooth Operation] This traditional laptop computers features 16GB DDR4 memory modules. Compared to DDR3, it allows the system to access memory modules quickly, significantly improving data transmission speed and multitasking capability. The 256GB NVME SSD provides fast and reliable storage for all your files, documents, and media without compromising on speed.

[15.6'' 1080 IPS Display for Clear Visual Experience] With a 15.6-inch 1080P, three-sided slim-bezel NanoEdge  display, this 15.6 laptop offers vibrant colors and wide viewing angles for an immersive multimedia experience. Stay connected with built-in Wi-Fi 5 and Bluetooth capabilities, while the HDMI port allows you to connect to external displays or projectors. The integrated webcam makes video conferencing and online meetings a breeze.

[Backlight Keyboard, Stay Productive Around the Clock] Enjoy effortless typing in any environment with this precision-engineered backlit keyboard. Adjustable brightness (Fn+F5) ensures optimal visibility in low-light settings—perfect for late-night work, travel, or cozy movie nights. The soft, uniform LED glow minimizes eye strain while adding a premium aesthetic to your business laptop.
[Your Satisfaction Guaranteed] We stand by every laptop with a 2-year hassle-free warranty, 24/7 customer support.
